name_suspect_examples.en: Manual verification: Although the YouTube title is the same as that of the Women’s 72kg Final (Yuka Fujikura vs. Asahi Nakamura), the video actually shows the Greco-Roman 72kg Final between Issei Honmyo and Teishin Honmyo (verified by the site administrator).
